title: Woodworking shop and cement plant on left west bank
description: August 30, 1959, Beverley and Bill Hayward stand on the eastern deck to see the progress. To the left of the west end, the white building was the cement plant, and the next level down was the woodworking building. The causeways were on both sides of the piers. (Photo courtesy of Melanie Antworth.)
